material:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request_target:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Build
        run: make build
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: node:20-alpine
    steps:
      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test
      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
generator_cmd: cat > t3.yml <<'EOF' (hand-authored synthetic GitHub Actions workflow, heredoc; no lib code)
oracle_cmd: python3 -I -c "import yaml,sys;d=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(','.join(k for k,j in d['jobs'].items() if 'container' in j))" t3.yml
